title: Confirm zoning and permitted use
summary: Confirm the zoning, that the current and planned uses are allowed, and any open code violations.
outlineSteps: Identify the parcel and the jurisdiction that zones it
Find the zoning district and any overlay
Read the district's permitted uses against current and planned use
Check conditions, variances and nonconforming status
Get the certificate of occupancy and permit history
Ask the jurisdiction about open code violations
Check private deed restrictions and covenants
Check whether another tenant type could reuse the building
Note pending zoning or regulatory changes
Order a zoning report if the lender requires one
Record findings and open items in the diligence file
